note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a ROC 2(4), 3, 9, Enforcement Rules 7; A06b ROC 2(4), 3, 9, Enforcement Rules 7; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generally applicable provision), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, with no further limit on a child born abroad. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file. On 2026-11-03 the primary was read: Nationality Act (R.O.C.), amended 2024-05-24, Laws & Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Ministry of Justice, official English text, arts. 2, 3, 9, 11, 20. Every figure the file holds now rests on it, and the dataset is no longer cited. The English is the Ministry of Justice database's own translation; the Chinese text is the authoritative one.

sources.title: Nationality Act (R.O.C.), amended 2024-05-24, Laws & Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan), Ministry of Justice, official English text, arts. 2, 3, 9, 11, 20
sources.said: Article 2 A person shall have the nationality of the R.O.C. under any of the conditions provided by the following Subparagraphs: 1. His/her father or mother was a national of the R.O.C. when he/she was born. ... 3. He/she was born in the territory of the R.O.C., and his/her parents cannot be ascertained, or both were stateless persons. ... Article 3 ... 1. He/she has legally resided within the territory of the R.O.C. for more than 183 days each year for at least five consecutive years. ... Article 9 A foreign national applying for naturalization shall provide a certificate of loss of original nationality within one year from the day of permission for naturalization ... Article 11 Nationals of the R.O.C. under any of the following conditions may lose their nationality of the R.O.C. with the permission of the Ministry of the Interior: ... Article 20 A national of the R.O.C. who acquires the nationality of another country shall have no right to hold government offices of the R.O.C.
